messages.content:
I'm thrilled to welcome you to the CloudSync Pro project as your Product Manager. Over the next 8 weeks, we'll work together to create a clear, testable plan for our team to build from, ensuring that we capture everything you need to meet your team's needs.

Here's a brief summary of our project scope: We're building an end-to-end encrypted file sync tool specifically for creative teams like video editors and 3D artists, using peer-to-peer file transfer over LAN with zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM encryption. This tool will enable seamless collaboration and data sharing within these teams, while maintaining the highest levels of security and compliance.

Below, you'll find the initial Product Requirement Document (PRD), which highlights key scope priorities for our v1 MVP. Please take a moment to review it, and don't hesitate to ask questions or provide feedback.



Please feel free to ask me any questions or provide feedback on this initial PRD. I'm here to ensure that we're on the right track to deliver a product that meets your team's needs.
